attempted_ideas: Fine-Grained Block Quantization (Group Size=32) for A4A4

Naive A4A4.conclusion: Catastrophic failure due to LLM outliers crushing the dynamic range.

Dynamic Percentile Clipping (p=0.99).conclusion: Clipping outliers destroys the math. Outliers are critical to attention logic.

Fine-Grained Block Quantization (G=32).conclusion: Recovers English grammar but aggressive hallucinations persist.

Sparse-Dense Hybrid Attention.conclusion: Highest Math SNR but fails live generation. Extracting outliers interferes with structural timing like RoPE.
